Remark
[the fundamental group of a symmetric space is abelian]

Source: petersen:page-0405 ↗ rem:pet-ch10-exercise-symmetric-flow-axis 1. ch10:10.5.2Let $M$ be a symmetric space. Show that $A_p$ acting on $\pi _1(M,p)$ by $[\gamma ]\mapsto [\gamma ]^{-1}$ shows $\pi _1(M,p)$ is abelian. (Hint: every element of $\pi _1(M,p)$ is represented by a geodesic loop, which by section 4 is a closed geodesic.)
